categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in noise and vibration control technology for urban rail transit, including research and development, product manufacturing, engineering design, market promotion, testing consulting, and rail operation management engineering services. Its product portfolio includes vibration isolation systems, noise barriers, and intelligent monitoring and maintenance systems for rail infrastructure. It also extends services to industrial and civil buildings, mechanical equipment, and ship engineering sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include damping spring floating slab track isolation systems, prefabricated steel spring floating slabs, high-elasticity vibration isolation pads, and intelligent rail soundprint online monitoring and smart operation systems. The company employs advanced manufacturing methods such as factory prefabrication for track slabs and integrates IoT, cloud computing, big data, and AI for real-time monitoring and predictive maintenance. Production centers in Beijing and Guangzhou utilize digital, automated, and intelligent manufacturing processes with ERP, MES, and OA systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are urban rail transit owners and construction contractors, including major state-owned enterprises in infrastructure and rail transit sectors. The company serves 33 cities in China with over 150 rail transit lines, covering metro, light rail, and suburban rail systems. It also serves industrial clients such as power plants and cultural heritage sites for vibration and noise control applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant market presence in North China, East China, South China, Central China, Southwest, and Northwest regions. It has established sales and service networks in major provincial capitals and maintains dual headquarters in Beijing and Guangzhou. The company is also exploring international markets with participation in overseas metro project bids.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on product design, manufacturing, and integrated service delivery including installation, monitoring, and maintenance. It procures raw materials like steel springs and components from qualified suppliers and manages customized production to meet project-specific requirements.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing intelligent rail operation and maintenance through soundprint monitoring technology, expanding digital and AI-driven solutions, and developing comprehensive vibration and noise control systems. The company emphasizes R&D in high-speed rail vibration isolation, smart monitoring algorithms, and green low-carbon technologies. It also focuses on building an engineering technology center to support industry standards and innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of vibration isolation systems, noise barriers, and related equipment, as well as through technical consulting, engineering design, and smart operation service contracts. Sales are project-based, typically secured via bidding or competitive negotiation, with additional revenue from after-sales services and maintenance contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the Chinese urban rail vibration and noise control market, with a market share exceeding 40% in key cities. It has broken foreign technology monopolies with proprietary innovations and maintains competitive advantages through comprehensive product lines and integrated services. Competitors include domestic and international firms in rail infrastructure vibration control and environmental noise mitigation sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 359 million, a 30.7% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 11.15 million, a 773.15% increase. It maintains a strong order backlog of about RMB 674 million. The company has stable asset and equity bases with total assets around RMB 1.47 billion and net assets of RMB 1.27 billion at year-end 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through advanced, patented vibration isolation technologies and integrated smart monitoring systems that enable real-time, full-coverage rail infrastructure health assessment. Its solutions emphasize safety, efficiency, and environmental compliance, supporting green and intelligent urban rail development. The company’s comprehensive service chain from design to operation and its strong R&D capabilities provide customers with tailored, high-performance noise and vibration control solutions.
